mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS rising, or the IC < 0.03 over a 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 7% triggers expectations of labor market recovery, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 7% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite UNRATE falling below 7%, or the IC > 0.05 over a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (GDP) and HOUST (orders) signal robust demand growth, leading to expanded corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative despite both proxies rising, or the IC < 0.03 over a 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% during a late-cycle expansion regime signals easing monetary policy, lowering discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite FEDFUNDS falling below 1.5%, or the IC > 0.05 over a 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO (supply index) over 6 months indicates robust production capacity, reducing inflation expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative despite INDPRO rising, or the IC < 0.05 over a 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS (labor) crossing above 133,000 in a given month signals a labor market surge, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 133,000 in the prior month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative despite PAYEMS rising above 133,000, or the IC > 0.05 over a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO (supply index) over 12 months indicates robust production capacity, reducing inflation expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative despite INDPRO rising, or the IC < 0.05 over a 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 8% during a recession recovery regime signals improving labor market conditions, fostering corporate optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 8% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite UNRATE falling below 8%, or the IC > 0.05 over a 6-month window.
